title: Node evidence inspection
description: Objective: render node receipts, artifacts, findings, and blockers with explicit provenance and fail-closed missing-evidence behavior. Deliverable: apps/control-room/src/nodes/node-evidence.tsx and node-evidence.test.tsx, presentation-only sections using stable cr.inspector.section.{findings|artifacts|blockers}, cr.inspector.receipt.* IDs, full digest/type labels, and provenance affordances. NOT in scope: editing/rerunning evidence, fetching artifact bytes, timeline behavior, clean review, attempt transcript/journal, query-response schema invention, routing/mounting, or edits outside the two files. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/control-room typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/control-room exec vitest run src/nodes/node-evidence.test.tsx.
definitionOfDone: Focused tests distinguish receipt identity/result, artifact identity/type/digest, structured findings, and blocker state/owner under stable test IDs with text/icon/color truth encoding.
A missing/unreadable receipt, artifact digest, or provenance record renders explicit UNKNOWN and exposes no success wording or active evidence link.
Receipt/artifact/finding/blocker order is deterministic from the supplied projection and the component does not mutate, edit, rerun, or upgrade evidence.
node-evidence.tsx and node-evidence.test.tsx are each <=250 physical lines and the exact focused verification command exits 0.
taskRails: Links and digests are presentation facts, not proof by themselves; never upgrade them beyond the supplied truth class.
Do not add evidence mutation/rerun actions or import transport/storage internals.
Own and stage only apps/control-room/src/nodes/node-evidence.tsx and node-evidence.test.tsx.
